title: External Contact-Trace Validation of Post-Compromise Post-Quantum Recovery

relationship_to_study8.purpose: Test external timing/contact-trace sensitivity without rewriting the frozen 3,456-position Study 8 record.

research_questions.RQ1: What contact-window duration, inter-contact-gap, contact-count, and clustering structure is observed in prospectively selected public satellite contact traces under a frozen source-selection rule?
research_questions.RQ2: For the frozen Study 8 cryptographic transition-object bundles replayed over externally observed contact windows, what minimum uniform effective payload rate is required to reach TRUST_RESTORED within each extension-only elapsed-time horizon?
research_questions.RQ3: Under the same externally observed timing traces and transition-object requirements, do the four frozen Study 8 policy semantics change the minimum-rate feasibility threshold or primarily redistribute transition-state costs and terminal failure classifications?
research_questions.RQ4: Which qualitative Study 8 findings remain directionally consistent, differ, or become non-identifiable when synthetic contact timing is replaced by external contact timing, without pooling the two evidence populations?

prohibited_semantic_substitutions: transmitter_baud is not usable recovery-byte throughput
observation status is not cryptographic trust or authorization
TLE epoch is not cryptographic epoch validity
observation existence is not proof of bidirectional command availability

primary_candidate_sources.source: ESA OPS-SAT-1 re-entry UHF telemetry dataset
primary_candidate_sources.dependency_note: ESA states that the amateur-radio community and SatNOGS network contributed receptions. This source must not be counted as an independent replication of SatNOGS timing evidence.

secondary_sources.source: LENS LEO Satellite Network Measurement Dataset
secondary_sources.use_boundary: May provide empirical LEO-network throughput/latency context in a separately frozen sensitivity layer. It is not spacecraft TT&C evidence and is not used to infer SatNOGS or OPS-SAT link capacity.
May be used in a separately authorized implementation layer after the external-trace results are frozen. It is not evidence for contact availability by itself.

satnogs_population_selection_rule.invalid_window_rule: Records with missing/nonparseable start or end, or end <= start, are invalid source records and remain accounted for in a validation report; they are not repaired.
satnogs_population_selection_rule.fill_rule: Traverse deterministic hash rank and admit a pair only while both caps remain satisfied; stop at 32. If fewer than 32 qualify, include all qualifying pairs that satisfy caps.

contact_trace_mapping.satnogs_contact_window: For a valid selected observation, use source start and end as the external timing window. The window establishes timing availability only.
contact_trace_mapping.overlap_rule: Within one selected norad_cat_id x ground_station trace, overlapping or directly abutting source windows are merged into one union interval for timing arithmetic; source observation IDs remain retained for provenance.
contact_trace_mapping.uniform_effective_payload_rate_definitio: A hypothetical constant net payload bit rate available only during accepted contact windows. It is a solved threshold parameter, not an observed SatNOGS throughput.
contact_trace_mapping.crypto_objects: Reuse exact frozen Study 8 standardized cryptographic-object byte requirements read-only.
contact_trace_mapping.policy_semantics: Reuse the four frozen Study 8 policy/state semantics read-only under a separately versioned extension runner.
contact_trace_mapping.disruption_semantics: Reuse A0-A3 mechanistically only after an extension-specific implementation test proves their event ordering is unambiguous under continuous elapsed time.
contact_trace_mapping.horizon_boundary: TRUST_RESTORED must occur strictly before anchor_time + horizon.
contact_trace_mapping.anchor_rule: Each accepted external contact-window end time is a candidate compromise anchor. Only anchors with complete source coverage through the full 24-hour follow-up horizon are eligible for all primary horizon comparisons.

permitted: whether the exact Study 8 null policy contrast persists under the extension population
whether profile burden remains non-increasing in matched extension conditions
whether external timing creates different feasibility ordering than the four synthetic regimes
prohibited: calling Study 8 externally validated solely because Study 8E is run
converting Study 8 logical slots to seconds
using Study 8E to relabel the original Study 8 estimand

statistics_rule: Treat each frozen external source population as a finite observed population. Report exact counts, proportions, medians, quantiles, threshold distributions, and matched deterministic contrasts. Do not add sampling p-values or confidence intervals unless a separate sampling model is prospectively introduced before endpoint inspection.
independence_rule: Shared provenance, shared ground-station network, shared mission, shared derived artifact, or shared collection pipeline must be recorded. OPS-SAT-1 reception evidence is explicitly dependent in part on SatNOGS and may not be counted as independent replication.

reused_governance_patterns: freeze dataset selection before endpoint inspection
bind source artifact identities and hashes before analysis
record protocol deviations prospectively rather than silently repair

hard_prohibitions: No modification of S8-PQC-ICR-001 frozen scientific files, observations, results, or hashes.
No modification of S8-ACTA-PKGFREEZE-002 submitted publisher files or hashes.
No external row access before source-selection and mapping freeze is merged.
No capacity inference from SatNOGS transmitter_baud.
No assumption that a SatNOGS observation window is an authenticated/bidirectional command window.
No use of OPS-SAT reception timestamps as independent replication of SatNOGS without provenance qualification.
No use of LENS throughput as spacecraft TT&C throughput.
No physical-time reinterpretation of original Study 8 logical slots.
No post-result source selection, threshold tuning, field repair, row dropping, or semantic remapping except through a documented protocol deviation that preserves the original record.
stopping_rules: Freeze the protocol and candidate-source roles before external data rows are accessed.
Perform only schema/metadata verification needed to bind source identity before population selection.
Freeze the exact SatNOGS selected trace-pair population before inspecting timing distributions or running recovery replay.
Freeze source artifact/API extraction identities and SHA-256 manifests before endpoint computation.
Freeze extension runner semantics and independent-audit path on synthetic fixtures before canonical external-trace execution.

If a source field needed by the primary mapping is malformed outside its documented domain, do not repair or selectively salvage rows after endpoint inspection; record a protocol deviation and determine whether the affected mapping becomes ambiguous or the source is excluded under the predeclared rule.
No manuscript claim based on Study 8E is permitted until canonical results are separately frozen and independently audited.
